answer: One concrete Sybil defense is non-transferable graded history: each identity must slowly build a delta of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Low-effort or duplicated work is treated as soft shale that erodes under peer review. An attacker crossing into the tundra of a large farm faces rising marginal cost because every new fake account requires its own independent trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without detection and slash.
